
```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(httpgd)
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(yardstick)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(vroom)


vroom("simulation_runs/sim_all_euk_genome_mixtures/all_euk_genome_mapping.csv") %>%
    filter(
        str_detect(species, "candida albicans") |
        str_detect(species, "candida dubliniensis") | 
        str_detect(species, "entamoeba dispar") | 
        str_detect(species, "entamoeba histo")
    ) %>%
    select(-mix_id, -sim_fcov, -normalized_fcov) %>%
    expand_grid(sim_fcov = c(0.25,0.5,0.75, 1)) %>%
    mutate(mix_id = row_number()) %>% 
    write_csv("sim_loo_mapping.csv")




```
